Shell.demo: You’re in the demo. Northfield and its people are fictional, and nothing here reaches a real college. To use your own campus, sign out and create an account.
Shell.unverified: Waiting for verification. The admin office is checking your roll number. You can browse and add training now; requests unlock once you’re verified.

Login.title: Sign in to your campus

Login.created: Account created. Sign in with your email and password.
Login.deleted: Your account is deleted. Thanks for using Baanto.

Login.demoNote: Fictional demo accounts. Password for all:
Login.checkEmail: Almost there. We sent a link to your email. Open it to confirm your address, then sign in.
Login.linkExpired: That link has expired or was already used. Sign in, or ask for a new one.

Signup.title: Create your account
Signup.lede: For students, researchers and faculty at any institute on Baanto. Lab in-charges: sign up as a researcher, and your admin office will make you an owner.

steps.s1Text: Name, campus, roll number. Takes a minute.
steps.s2Text: They match your roll number against the college register. Until then you can browse everything.
steps.s3Text: Upload a certificate or induction slip for each lab you want to use.
steps.s4Text: Anything your pass unlocks is one request away.

Signup.notListed: Not listed? <link>Ask your institute to register</link> or register it yourself if you run its labs.
Signup.rollHint: As printed on your college ID.
Signup.emailHint: Your college email if you have one. You’ll sign in with it.
Signup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters, with a letter and a number.
Signup.consent: I agree to the <terms>terms of use</terms> and the <link>privacy notice</link>. My name, roll number and booking history are shared only with my campus.

errors.rollNo: Use the roll number on your college ID: 4–20 letters, numbers, / or -.
errors.consent: Agree to the privacy notice to continue.
errors.deptMismatch: That department isn’t part of the campus you chose.
errors.rollTaken: An account with this roll number already exists. Sign in, or ask the admin office.
errors.emailTaken: An account with this email already exists. Sign in instead.
errors.failed: We couldn’t create the account just now. Try again in a minute.
errors.bot: Something went wrong. Reload the page and try again.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts from here. Wait a few minutes and try again.

People.intro: Unverified accounts can browse but cannot request anything. Lab in-charges sign up themselves; verify them, then make them owners here. Every change needs a reason and is written to the audit chain.
